title: Information processing method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an information processing method, an information processing device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium; the related embodiments can be applied to various scenes such as cloud technology, artificial intelligence, intelligent transportation, auxiliary driving and the like. According to the method, after interaction information to be processed is obtained, interaction objects participating in interaction are extracted from the interaction information to be processed, after an interaction object set is obtained, target interaction information of each interaction object in the interaction object set is respectively screened out from a preset interaction information set, interaction characteristics of the interaction objects are extracted from the target interaction information, then the interaction characteristics are converted into time sequence characteristics, then the time sequence characteristics are fused to obtain target time sequence characteristics corresponding to the interaction information to be processed, and then target information of the interaction information to be processed is determined according to the target time sequence characteristics; the scheme can improve the accuracy of information processing.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, image acquisition method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium
abstract: An information processing device is configured to perform an operation of a delivery service in which an inside of a vehicle, a building, or a facility used by a user is designated as a delivery destination of a package, or perform a support of the operation. The information processing device includes an information acquisition unit configured to acquire information on an accommodation situation of an object accommodated inside the vehicle, the building, or the facility, and an accommodation situation notification unit configured to notify the user of the accommodation situation based on the information acquired by the information acquisition unit.

title: Monitoring node, monitoring system, terminal equipment and service system
abstract: The disclosure relates to a monitoring node, a monitoring system, a terminal device and a service system. The monitoring node includes a thermal imaging camera, a processor, and a wireless module. The thermal imaging camera is disposed within the monitored area at a first predetermined height from the ground surface with the optical axis substantially perpendicular to the ground surface to thermally image a corresponding imaging area on the ground surface. And the processor analyzes the thermal imaging graph to obtain an analysis result. The wireless module wirelessly broadcasts the analysis results, and/or the thermal imaging map. The present disclosure is mainly applied to building indoor spaces, and also to interior spaces of large-sized devices such as trains, ships, airplanes, and the like. According to the method and the device, accurate identification analysis and positioning of the on-site object target in the monitoring area can be achieved at the single node end, and the analysis result and/or the thermal imaging image can be broadcast to the receiving terminal with wireless receiving capability in the monitoring area, so that accurate active and passive positioning functions can be provided for the object target, and other related purposes can be supported.

title: Autonomous mobile device and control method thereof
abstract: An autonomous mobile device and a control method are disclosed. The autonomous mobile device includes a main body and an imaging device, a detecting device, a light source assembly, and a controller disposed at the main body. The imaging device is configured to acquire image information in a predetermined direction of the main body. The predetermined direction includes an upward direction of the main body. The detecting device is configured to detect obstacle information in the upward direction of the main body. A light outputting direction of the light source assembly includes the upward direction of the main body. The controller is configured to, when the detecting device detects the obstacle within a predetermined distance range in the upward direction of the main body, control the light source assembly to turn on to provide illumination for the imaging device.

title: Image recognition device
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the image recognition device technique and specifically relates to indicate an image recognition device, it includes unable adjustment base, the erection column, the control box, the installation guide rail, electronic slider, the electric jar, flexible post, rotatable electronic connector and camera, unable adjustment base's top and erection column fixed connection, the control box is installed in the rear end surface of erection column, the installation guide rail is installed in the front end surface of erection column, electronic slider slides and locates on the installation guide rail, the front end surface of electronic slider and the rear end fixed surface of electric jar are connected, the electric jar is connected with flexible post drive, the one end fixed connection of flexible post and rotatable electronic connector, the other end and the camera fixed connection of rotatable electronic connector, the internally mounted of control box has the main control system who is used for accepting camera image information. The image recognition device is convenient to change the camera shooting position of the camera and convenient to operate.

title: Array substrate and fabricating method thereof, reflective display panel, and display device
abstract: The present disclosure provides an array substrate. The array substrate includes a base on which pixel electrodes, gate lines, data lines, and thin film transistors are disposed. The data lines and the gate lines are alternately arranged to define a plurality of pixel units one-to-one corresponding to the pixel electrodes and the thin film transistors. An insulating layer is disposed between the pixel electrodes and a layer where a data pattern is located. The data pattern, part of which is overlapped with the pixel electrodes, includes the data lines and source electrodes of the thin film transistors. The insulating layer is provided with recesses, and an orthographic projection of the recess on the base is outside of an orthographic projection of an overlapping region of the pixel electrode and the data pattern on the base.

title: Display device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A display device includes a driving substrate, a plurality of light-emitting elements, a light-shielding layer and a sensor. The plurality of light-emitting elements and the sensor are disposed on the drive substrate. The light-shielding layer is disposed between the plurality of light-emitting and further covers part of an upper surface of the sensor, where satisfies the conditions of: H 1 >H 2 >H 3 ; H 1 is a height from a light-emitting surface of the light-emitting element to the driving substrate, H 2 is a height of the light-shielding layer on the driving substrate, and H 3 is the height from an upper surface of the light-shielding layer to the driving substrate. A method of manufacturing a display device is also proposed.

title: Array substrate, manufacturing method thereof and display panel
abstract: The invention discloses an array substrate, a manufacturing method thereof and a display panel. The array substrate comprises a substrate, an active switch and a transparent electrode layer, wherein the active switch comprises a first metal layer, an adhesion layer arranged on the first metal layer, a first insulating layer arranged on the adhesion layer, and a through hole penetrating through the first insulating layer and exposing the first metal layer; the transparent electrode layer is connected with the first metal layer through a through hole; the adhesive force between the adhesion layer and the first insulating layer is larger than that between the first metal layer and the first insulating layer; therefore, the first insulating layer is easy to adhere to the first metal layer during deposition, and the etching speed of the first insulating layer is relatively low due to the good adhesion, so that the undercutting phenomenon is improved.

title: Display device and manufacturing method
abstract: The invention discloses a display device and a manufacturing method, wherein the display device comprises a color film substrate, an array substrate and a liquid crystal layer positioned between the color film substrate and the array substrate, wherein the liquid crystal layer comprises liquid crystal molecules and dye liquid crystal molecules mixed with the liquid crystal molecules; a lateral light source is arranged on the side surface of the array substrate, a reflecting layer is arranged on one side of the array substrate away from the liquid crystal layer, and a light collecting structure is arranged on the color film substrate and/or the array substrate; the surface of the array substrate, which is parallel to the color film substrate, is provided with light guide dots, and the light guide dots are used for guiding light rays emitted by the lateral light source to the direction of the array substrate, which is far away from the light guide dots. The light guide mesh points are arranged on the array substrate, the side-in light source is directly arranged on the side face of the array substrate, the color film substrate and/or the array substrate are/is also provided with the light collecting structure, and the liquid crystal molecules are mixed with dye liquid crystal molecules, so that a backlight module and a lower polarizer are not required to be additionally arranged, and the thickness of the display device is greatly reduced.

title: Display panel, preparation method thereof and display device
abstract: The display panel comprises a substrate, a pixel defining layer and a first packaging layer, wherein the pixel defining layer and the first packaging layer are positioned on the substrate, the first packaging layer is positioned on one side, away from the substrate, of the pixel defining layer, the density of at least part of the pixel defining layer is larger than that of the first packaging layer, or the refractive index of at least part of the pixel defining layer is larger than that of the first packaging layer. In the display panel, the degree of etching of the pixel defining layer can be reduced in the process of etching the first packaging layer by increasing the density of the pixel defining layer, so that the structure below the pixel defining layer is protected, and the yield of the display panel is ensured.

title: Wireless communication device, terminal equipment, signal processing method and system
abstract: The application discloses a wireless communication device, terminal equipment, a signal processing method and a system, wherein the wireless communication device comprises a signal selection module, a radio frequency module and a baseband module, wherein the signal selection module is connected with the radio frequency module; the signal selection module is connected with the baseband module; the signal selection module is used for selecting the first signal and the second signal and outputting the first signal and the second signal to the baseband module; the first signal is input to the signal selection module through the radio frequency module, and the second signal is not input to the signal selection module through the radio frequency module.

title: Communication device, control method, base station, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides communication equipment, a control method, a base station and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the communication equipment comprises a transmitting link, a receiving link, an antenna module, a coupling module, a correction frequency conversion module and a logic module, wherein the antenna module is respectively connected with the transmitting link and the receiving link, the coupling module is respectively connected with the transmitting link, the receiving link and the antenna module, the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the transmitting link and/or the receiving link, when the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the transmitting link, the correction frequency conversion module is controlled to work, the transmitting link can transmit a first correction signal of a second frequency point, the receiving link can receive the first correction signal and transmit the first correction signal to the logic module for correction of a radio frequency signal, and when the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the receiving link, the transmitting link can transmit the second correction signal of the first frequency point, and the correction frequency conversion module is controlled to work so that the receiving link can receive the second correction signal and transmit the second correction signal to the logic module for correction of the radio frequency signal.

title: Radio frequency signal processing device and communication equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a radio frequency signal processing device and communication equipment, wherein the device comprises a receiving circuit, a transmitting circuit, a first baseband module, a second baseband module, a receiving multiplexing circuit and a transmitting multiplexing circuit, wherein the receiving multiplexing circuit is respectively in signal connection with the receiving circuit, the first baseband module and the second baseband module, the transmitting multiplexing circuit is respectively in signal connection with the transmitting circuit, the first baseband module and the second baseband module, and the first baseband module and the second baseband module respectively process the receiving and transmitting data of different communication standards. By using the scheme of the utility model, the area and the cost of the module or the communication equipment can be reduced, and the complexity of terminal implementation can be reduced.

title: Wireless communication method and apparatus, communication device, and storage medium
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of wireless communications. Disclosed are a wireless communication method and apparatus, a communication device, and a storage medium. The wireless communication method comprises: acquiring a long-term signal-to-noise ratio measurement value for performing signal-to-noise ratio measurement on a wireless communication signal; adaptively selecting a filter coefficient according to the long-term signal-to-noise ratio measurement value, and performing infinite impulse response low-pass filtering according to the selected filter coefficient to obtain a stable long-term estimation value; and performing signal compensation according to the long-term estimation value, and updating the long-term estimation value according to an actual compensation value.

title: Electronic device, communication method, storage medium and computer program product
abstract: The present application relates to an electronic device and a method in a wireless communication system. An electronic device for a user equipment UE side, the UE comprising a plurality of antenna panels, the electronic device comprising: a processing circuit configured to: receive one or more downlink reference signals, DL RSs, from a base station via the plurality of antenna panels; and providing a beam report to the base station, the beam report indicating an association of the plurality of antenna panels with the one or more DL RSs, wherein the beam report comprises: a panel state of at least one of the plurality of antenna panels; an index of at least one of the one or more DL RSs received via the at least one antenna panel; and a channel quality measurement result for the at least one DL RS, is disclosed.

title: Trimming, centering and deviation rectifying device
abstract: The utility model discloses a trimming centering and deviation rectifying device, which comprises a processing table, wherein centering and deviation rectifying mechanisms are symmetrically arranged in front and back of the upper surface of the processing table, a feeding mechanism is arranged at the position, close to the top, of the outer side wall of the processing table, the feeding mechanism is arranged at the position between the two centering and deviation rectifying mechanisms, after a motor joint is connected with a motor shaft of a servo motor through a coupler, the servo motor drives a threaded screw rod to rotate, so that a displacement frame moves forwards and backwards under the limit of a limit plate, the maximum extension position of a piston rod of a clamping buffer oil cylinder is adjusted, the clamping buffer oil cylinder is started, the piston rod drives a clamping plate to move towards the direction close to the center of the processing table, so that a plate is centered and deviated on the upper surface of the processing table, the trimming precision is improved, safe feeding can be realized by arranging a feeding mechanism, and the situation that an operator needs to enter the inside of a trimming machine to carry out feeding operation is avoided, the potential safety hazard is eliminated.

title: Pendulum-type milling machine sealing device
abstract: The utility model discloses a sealing device of a pendulum type pulverizer, which comprises the pendulum type pulverizer, wherein a feeding pipe is fixedly connected to the side wall of the pendulum type pulverizer, and a sealing structure is arranged at the other end of the feeding pipe. When using pendulum-type milling machine, set up seal structure in advance at the tip of inlet pipe, the one end of sack pipe is the rubber tube other end for cloth, the sack one end and the piping connection of discharging equipment of sack pipe are provided with the rubber circle simultaneously, the inside of sack pipe is provided with the rubber circle, carry out the centre gripping by outside symmetry semicircle board again, fix the sack pipe in discharging equipment's pipeline outside and seal, also can select the semicircle board of different specifications with the specification according to the pipeline, ensure whole sealed effect, avoid can causing the dust to fly upward, be provided with the fan simultaneously in the one end of inlet pipe, inwards blow air when the unloading, increase the extra spacing to the material, avoid the material backward flow to produce the dust, moreover the sack pipe simple structure, easily install and dismantle, can wash and change the sack conveniently.

title: Base for friction press
abstract: The utility model discloses a base for a friction press, which comprises two support plates and guard plates, wherein the two support plates are symmetrically arranged and connected through the guard plates, the outer wall of a piston rod of a first hydraulic cylinder is fixedly provided with a lifting structure, the lifting structure is penetrated and assembled on the inner wall of the support plate, the side wall of each support plate is symmetrically provided with two support wheel structures, the whole equipment can be lifted up through the action of the support wheel structures, so that the whole equipment is lifted off the ground, the equipment is conveniently displaced, the friction press is conveniently moved, the transportation stability of the friction press is ensured, when the friction press is moved to a proper placement position, the first hydraulic cylinder is controlled to retract the piston rod, the clamping plate is adjusted to be separated from the side wall of the friction press, the lifting structure is withdrawn, the friction press is relocated on the ground, the process needs to be matched with lifting tools such as a gantry crane, the stability when the friction press is placed is controlled, the use is convenient, and the practicability is strong.

title: F-shaped rod punching clamp
abstract: The utility model relates to a F-shaped rod punching clamp, which comprises a base, wherein a transverse rod positioning module is connected on the base, and a vertical rod positioning chute is arranged on one side of the transverse rod positioning module on the base; the cross rod positioning module comprises a supporting vertical plate, the supporting vertical plate is connected with three supporting transverse plates arranged at intervals at one side of the vertical rod positioning sliding groove, and a cross rod placing cavity is formed between every two adjacent supporting transverse plates; the three supporting transverse plates are respectively provided with a drilling guide hole and a limiting slot which are correspondingly arranged, and an inserting plate is inserted in the limiting slot; a F shape pole anchor clamps that punch, adopt horizontal pole orientation module cooperation montant location spout, the hole site on two horizontal poles of clamping processing, easy operation improves machining efficiency.

title: Screw feeder blade forming device
abstract: The utility model discloses an auger blade forming device, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein the upper end surface of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with two supporting plates which are symmetrically arranged, the upper ends of the supporting plates are respectively and fixedly provided with a fixed block, the inside of the fixed block is provided with a limit component, one side of the limit components which are close to each other is provided with a connecting component, a limit slider is arranged between the limit component and the connecting component, the upper end of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a driving component, and the power output end of the driving component is respectively and fixedly connected with the connecting component, simultaneously still improved the stability of screw feeder blade shaping body.

title: Wisdom is switching power supply box for energy storage
abstract: The application discloses switching power supply box for wisdom energy storage includes: the power box comprises a power box body, wherein a circuit connecting seat is arranged on the outer surface of one side of the power box body, a battery installation cavity and an auxiliary cavity are formed in the power box body, the battery installation cavity is located above the auxiliary cavity, a plurality of groups of battery installation assemblies are arranged in the battery installation cavity, and a movable installation seat and a circuit connecting device are arranged in the auxiliary cavity. The utility model provides a switching power supply box for wisdom energy storage, part electron device and lithium cell, the heat is not concentrated during the use, and the circuit can not all be concentrated together in addition, can make things convenient for people to overhaul the inside electronic instrument of power supply box, can improve the fixed effect of lithium cell, and the installation of lithium cell is more convenient with the dismantlement, can make things convenient for people to maintain, can adjust circuit length, can make things convenient for people to take out the mounting panel and look over, make things convenient for people to overhaul, bring better use prospect.

title: Battery switch driving circuit
abstract: The present invention provides a battery switch driving circuit for driving a battery switch using a switch, a capacitor, and a diode. The battery switch driving circuit according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a first battery input terminal and a second battery input terminal; a converter positioned between the first battery input terminal and the second battery input terminal; a switch positioned between the second battery input terminal and the converter to interrupt power input to the second battery input terminal when turned off; and a switch driving unit configured to turn on the first switch. The switch driving unit includes a first capacitor that is charged and discharged depending on the on/off operation of a second switch that operates with a PWM signal, and a second capacitor that is charged according to the on/off operation of the second switch by a voltage charged in the first capacitor.

title: Lithium battery charging and discharging equipment and system
abstract: The utility model relates to a lithium battery charging and discharging equipment and system, wherein, this lithium battery charging and discharging equipment includes: a cabinet having a plurality of bay locations; wherein, each warehouse is provided with a pulse power supply module, a press machine module, a temperature control module and a bearing module; the input end of the pulse power supply module is connected with a high-voltage direct-current power supply, and the output end of the pulse power supply module is connected with the press machine module; when the lithium battery is placed in the bearing module, the press machine module is connected to the lithium battery so as to realize the electrical connection between the pulse power supply module and the lithium battery; the temperature control module is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet so as to realize the cooling of each storage position through water circulation. The utility model discloses an adopt high voltage direct current power as input power to and adopt hydrologic cycle to realize the cooling of equipment, the charge-discharge efficiency who has solved lithium cell battery charging and discharging equipment is low, and the low area of equipment integration degree is big, the poor problem of samming effect in the equipment.

title: Battery pack and electric automobile
abstract: The utility model discloses a battery pack and an electric automobile. The battery panel includes: the battery comprises a plurality of battery cells, a flexible composite row, a battery energy distribution module, a control module and an external interface. The flexible composite row is connected with the battery core; the battery energy distribution module is connected with the flexible composite row; the control module is connected with the battery energy distribution module; the control module is used for controlling the on-off of the battery energy distribution module; the external interface is connected with the control module; the external interface is used for being connected with an external circuit; the circuit of the battery energy distribution module connected with the external interface is configured as a high-voltage circuit; the loop of the control module connected with the external interface is configured as a low-voltage loop; the low-pressure circuit and the high-pressure circuit are provided separately. The embodiment of the utility model is beneficial to enhancing the shock resistance and the control reliability of the battery pack.

title: Negative pole piece and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The application relates to a negative pole piece, a preparation method and application thereof. The negative electrode plate comprises a current collector, and a first active layer, a conductive layer and a second active layer which are sequentially laminated on the surface of the current collector; the material of the first active layer includes a first active material including a carbon material; the material of the conductive layer comprises a conductive agent; the material of the second active layer includes a second active material including a sheet-like silicon-based material. The negative electrode plate can enable the battery to have higher specific capacity and cycle stability.

title: Polysaccharide modified phospholipid complex and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a polysaccharide-modified medicinal phospholipid compound, wherein the medicinal phospholipid compound is prepared from a medicament and phospholipid, the medicament comprises oxymatrine and glycyrrhizin, and the polysaccharide modification is to modify the medicinal phospholipid compound by chitosan and then modify the medicinal phospholipid compound coated with chitosan by hyaluronic acid. The polysaccharide modified medicinal phospholipid complex can enhance medicinal aggregation in tumor cells through synergistic effect and active targeting effect, and remarkably improves the antitumor effect of the medicaments.

title: Long-chain fatty acid glycerol alcohol compound Rubracin B, preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The application relates to a long-chain fatty acid glycerol alcohol compound Rubracin B in the technical field of microorganisms, the structure of which is shown as the following formula: the compound is obtained by fermenting and extracting the phaeosphaeria rubra, the phaeosphaeria rubra is named as phaeosphaeria rubra Tubeufia PF02-2, and the preservation unit is as follows: china center for type culture Collection, the preservation number is CCTCC NO: m2019957. The compound has the application of preparing tumor drug resistance reversal agent or tumor drug sensitizer.

title: Resveratrol nanoparticle and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a resveratrol nanoparticle and a preparation method thereof, wherein the resveratrol nanoparticle consists of resveratrol, phosphatidylcholine and sophorolipid, the particle size of the resveratrol nanoparticle is less than or equal to 65nm, the polydispersity index (PDI) is less than 0.2, the absolute value of zeta potential is more than or equal to 15mV, the drug loading rate of resveratrol is more than or equal to 29 percent, the invention also provides a preparation method for preparing the resveratrol nanoparticle, the preparation method successfully prepares the resveratrol nanoparticle with high encapsulation rate, high stability and obviously improved safety by adopting a safe solvent system, a simple and efficient process, natural green auxiliary materials and a freeze-drying stabilization technology, and simultaneously solves the technical problem that the resveratrol is easy to be interfered by factors such as light, heat, oxygen and the like to lose biological activity.

title: Lipoic acid modified targeted integrin alpha v beta 3 nano-polypeptide carrier and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, in particular to a lipoic acid modified targeted integrin alpha v beta 3 nano-polypeptide carrier and a preparation method and application thereof. The nano-carrier provided by the invention is crosslinked by adopting a disulfide bond of lipoic acid, a formed polypeptide polymer can be rapidly degraded in cells and cannot be accumulated in the cells, arginine, aspartic acid, glycine and cysteine in the polypeptide are all in-vivo amino acids and have no toxic or side effect on cells and human bodies, and a CCK-8 method cell proliferation test shows that the prepared nano-carrier has very low cytotoxicity and simultaneously has better gene and chemotherapeutic drug co-loading capacity.

title: Uniform polysaccharide from Xiaoyao powder as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a uniform polysaccharide from a Xiaoyao powder source, and a preparation method and application thereof. The homogeneous polysaccharide consists of arabinose, galactose, mannose, glucose and fructose, and has a weight average molecular weight Mw of 293.223 kDa. The polysaccharide is obtained by separating and purifying from XIAOYAO powder by water extraction, alcohol precipitation, ion exchange column chromatography and gel column chromatography. Experimental results show that the uniform polysaccharide can improve the behavior of a cortisol-induced zebra fish depression model, improve the exercise activity, has the antidepressant activity, and can be used for preparing medicaments for treating or preventing depression.

title: PET composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a PET composition and a preparation method thereof, wherein the PET composition comprises, by weight, 40-50 parts of PET, 5-12 parts of polyvinyl alcohol, 1-5 parts of epoxy resin, 0.3-10mol% of IPA monomer in the PET, and 79-96.5 mol% of alcoholysis degree of the polyvinyl alcohol. According to the invention, PET with specific IPA monomer content and polyvinyl alcohol with specific alcoholysis degree are selected, so that the adhesive strength and hydrolysis resistance can be remarkably improved.

title: Hybrid polymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a hybrid polymer and a preparation method and application thereof. The repeating unit structure of the hybrid polymer of the present invention is as follows: the preparation method of the hybrid polymer of the invention comprises the following steps: 1) carrying out reaction of trisilanol isooctyl-POSS and vinyl trichlorosilane to obtain a compound 1; 2) carrying out the reaction of the compound 1 and mercaptoethylamine hydrochloride to obtain a compound 2; 3) carrying out a reaction of the compound 2 and cis-5-norbornene-exo-2, 3-dicarboxylic anhydride to obtain a monomer; 4) carrying out polymerization reaction of the monomers to obtain the hybrid polymer. The hybrid polymer has the advantages of light weight, high strength, easy processing and forming, low cost, environmental friendliness and the like, and is suitable for large-scale popularization and application.

title: Easily-cleaned scratch-resistant polypropylene material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an easy-to-clean scratch-resistant polypropylene material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the easy-to-clean scratch-resistant polypropylene material is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 100 parts of polypropylene resin, 1-5 parts of unsaturated carboxylic acid, 0.2-0.5 part of an initiator, 1-2 parts of a dispersion solvent, 0.1-0.3 part of an antioxidant 1#, 0.05-0.3 part of a catalyst, 0.3-1.2 parts of an antioxidant 2#, 0.5-2.5 parts of a lubricant and 0.8-1.0X parts of perfluoroalkyl alcohol, wherein X= (M 1 /M 1 ×M 2 )×N;m 1 is the added mass of the unsaturated carboxylic acid, M 1 is the molecular weight of the unsaturated carboxylic acid, M 2 is the molecular weight of perfluoroalkyl alcohol, and N is the carboxylic acid number of the unsaturated carboxylic acid.

title: Metal ion catalyzed tannin resin foaming material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a metal ion catalyzed tannin resin foaming material and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: s1, dissolving metal salt ions in water, and controlling the mass fraction to be 1% -5%; s2, adding tannin, furfuryl alcohol and a metal ion solution into a foaming mold, and uniformly stirring; s3, adding a stabilizer and a cross-linking agent, continuously stirring uniformly, adding a catalyst, stirring at a high speed until the resin heats and foams, standing at room temperature for 2 hours, and transferring into an oven for drying treatment after the resin foams and is pre-cured to obtain a foaming material, wherein the mass ratio of the tannin to the furfuryl alcohol is 1:1; the invention provides a metal ion catalytic foaming technology, and the obtained foaming material has good appearance, uniform cell distribution, excellent compression strength and other performances, and more obviously, the foaming technology greatly shortens the foaming time, improves the foaming efficiency and saves the production cost.

title: High-strength, light-weight and scratch-resistant polypropylene composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-strength, light-weight and scratch-resistant polypropylene composite material and a preparation method thereof. The polypropylene composite material is composed of the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 45-90% of polypropylene; 0.1-5% of polymer type nucleating agent; 0-15% of nano inorganic filler; 5-20% of micron inorganic filler; 5-20% of a toughening agent; 0.5-3% of anti-scratch auxiliary agent; 0.1 to 2 percent of stabilizer; 0-5% of other additives. The polymer type nucleating agent has stronger induced crystallization capability than inorganic filler, so that the polypropylene has higher crystallization temperature and mechanical strength, and the dosage of the inorganic filler can be reduced and the material density can be reduced on the premise of ensuring the high strength of the material. The nanometer inorganic filler replaces part of the conventional micron inorganic filler, so that the total amount of the inorganic filler can be further reduced, and the size of the material is kept stable. The reduction of the inorganic filler can weaken white scratches of the material caused by the exposure of the inorganic filler after being scratched, and the introduction of the scratch-resistant auxiliary agent can further improve the scratch-resistant capability of the material, so that the material can keep better surface appearance after being molded.

title: Energy-saving equipment
abstract: The utility model provides energy-saving equipment, which comprises an energy-saving box, wherein two supporting plates are arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the energy-saving box, ventilation grooves are formed in the two supporting plates, a water tank is arranged at the top of the two supporting plates, a water level sensor is arranged at the corner of the inner wall of the water tank, a ventilation hole is formed in the top of the water tank, and a transmission mechanism is communicated with the top of the energy-saving box in a sealing manner: when gas enters the energy-saving box, the gas firstly contacts the bottom of the water tank, the water tank is heated at high temperature, then the water tank is heated to be hot water, then the gas enters the top of the inner wall of the energy-saving box through the ventilation groove formed in the supporting plate, and enters the air delivery channel through the filter screen, and when the gas flows back from the air delivery channel, the power generation fan can be driven to rotate, then the power generated by the power generation fan is converted into electric power, the gas flows back to the boiler through the first connector for secondary use, and the utilization rate is improved.

title: Self-adaptive adjustment type Roots pump bypass device
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive adjustment type Roots pump bypass device. The invention adopts an electromagnetic regulating valve as a gas path regulating unit of the Roots pump inlet and outlet bypass device, utilizes a first Wheatstone bridge, a second Wheatstone bridge and an automatic regulating circuit to jointly form a circuit system of the bypass device, and is used as a center of the bypass device for power supply, signal processing and signal execution, hot wire resistors of the first Wheatstone bridge and the second Wheatstone bridge are used as measuring units of the inlet and outlet temperatures of the Roots pump, and the opening of an electromagnetic valve is regulated in real time by utilizing the balance of the Wheatstone bridge, so that the differential pressure at the inlet and outlet of the Roots pump is accurately controlled within a reasonable range, and the increase of energy consumption caused by the rough exhaust of a mechanical overflow valve is effectively reduced.

title: Ash conveying bin pump exhaust pipe with built-in blowing assisting device
abstract: The utility model provides an ash conveying bin pump exhaust pipe with a built-in blowing assisting device, which comprises an exhaust pipeline and a blowing assisting air box, wherein the upper end of the exhaust pipeline is provided with an air inlet, an oblique air inlet pipeline is arranged in the blowing assisting air box, the blowing assisting air box is arranged at the upper end of the exhaust pipeline, the tail end position of the oblique air inlet pipeline is butted with the air inlet, an air blower is arranged in the blowing assisting air box, the inner wall of one side of the upper end of the oblique air inlet pipeline is connected with a closed cover through a hinge, a containing shell is arranged on the inner wall of the upper side of the exhaust pipeline, an electric push rod is arranged in the containing shell, a sealing plate is arranged on an output shaft of the electric push rod and penetrates through the containing shell, the surface area of the sealing plate is larger than the area of the air inlet, the blowing assisting air box is arranged at the upper end of the exhaust pipeline, so that the blowing assisting device can blow the exhaust pipeline through the outside air, thereby preventing the exhaust duct from being clogged.

title: Water-reducing agent sprays recovery tower
abstract: The utility model discloses a water reducer spray recovery tower which comprises a tower body, a connecting block and a water tank, wherein an inclined plate is arranged in the tower body, a through hole is formed in the center of the surface of the inclined plate, a positioning box is connected to the bottom of the through hole, the connecting block is arranged on the inner side wall of the tower body, the number of the connecting blocks is two, water mist is formed by water through an atomization nozzle to spray water, water reducer particles in tail gas are adsorbed, a first motor drives a driving bevel gear to rotate, driven bevel gears and a filter cylinder are driven to rotate, water accumulated in the filter cylinder is rotated by the filter cylinder and then falls downwards, so that the water reducer particles are stored in the filter cylinder, the second motor controls the threaded rod to reciprocate all the time to spray the tail gas rapidly and evenly, the water can be filtered again through the filter hole, and resource waste is avoided.

title: Exhaust gas purifying tank with sealing element
abstract: The utility model provides an exhaust gas purifying tank with a sealing element, which comprises a purifying tank, wherein a spray ring pipe is arranged on an upper bolt on the inner wall of the purifying tank; a sealing end cover is arranged at the upper end of the purifying tank through bolts; the lower side of the purifying tank is connected with a liquid discharge valve in a threaded manner; the right lower side of the inside of the purifying tank is embedded with an air injection pipe; the upper right side of the inside of the purification tank is embedded with a liquid injection pipe, and the left end of the liquid injection pipe is in threaded connection with the spray ring pipe; the right end of the liquid injection pipe is connected with a one-way valve in a threaded manner; the lower end of the spray ring pipe is connected with a spray header in a threaded manner; the lower part of the inner wall of the purifying tank is provided with a dispersed air outlet pipe frame structure. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the scattered air outlet pipe frame structure, the sprayed absorption liquid is prevented from entering, so that the accumulation influences the work of air outlet of the injection pipe.

title: Commercial vehicle lane keeping control method considering roll stability
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of automobiles, in particular to a commercial vehicle lane keeping control method considering roll stability, which comprises the steps of firstly, establishing a vehicle dynamics model required by the research of transverse control and stability control, researching the control mechanism of the transverse control and the roll stability control of a vehicle and creating conditions for the construction of related controllers; secondly, designing a lane keeping controller of the commercial vehicle based on a related vehicle dynamics model and a vehicle state and combining with improved MPC, and calculating an optimal control amount to realize lane keeping control; finally, a commercial vehicle roll stability controller is designed based on the differential braking principle, wherein the upper controller is used for calculating an additional yaw moment required by the vehicle to maintain stability, and the lower controller is used for selecting a target braking wheel and calculating the target braking moment based on the differential braking principle. The invention solves the technical problems of poor lane keeping and roll stability control effects of the commercial vehicle and easy instability of the vehicle in the prior art.

title: Cooling device for cooling an electric power unit motor and at least one further component, and vehicle comprising such a cooling device
abstract: The invention relates to a cooling device for an electric machine (2) and at least one further component (4, 5) of an electric power unit: the cooling arrangement comprises an oil circuit (16), an oil pump for circulating oil to the electric machine (2), a first coolant circuit (6) configured to cool further components (5) of the electric power unit, and coolant radiator means (8 a, 8 b), wherein the coolant (6) in the first coolant circuit is cooled by air, the oil circuit (16) comprises an oil radiator (46), an oil radiator fan (47) configured to provide an adjustable air flow through the oil radiator (46), and a heat exchanger (15), wherein heat is transferred between the coolant in the first coolant circuit (6) and the oil in the oil circuit (16).

title: Drying device for digital printing machine
abstract: The application relates to a drying device for a digital printing machine, which comprises a shell for drying cloth, wherein a gas collecting pipe communicated with the interior of the shell is fixedly arranged on the shell, and the gas collecting pipe is connected with an air extractor; the outer side walls of the two sides of the gas collecting pipe are provided with mounting holes along the wall thickness direction of the gas collecting pipe in a penetrating manner, and the inner side walls of the two mounting holes are connected with mounting plates in a sliding manner; the mounting plate is provided with a ventilation hole in a penetrating manner along the length direction of the gas collecting pipe, and the inner side wall of the ventilation hole is provided with a filtering piece for filtering flowing gas in the gas collecting pipe; the filter piece comprises a filter screen and an adsorption layer which is positioned on one side of the filter screen close to the air extractor. The mounting panel need not to shut down the calico printing machine by the in-process of replacing to the clearance has been reduced or the change filters the influence to calico printing machine printing efficiency, is favorable to guaranteeing the printing efficiency of calico printing machine.

title: Breed ox sheep and use nutrition health care feed processing compounding device
abstract: The utility model discloses a breed ox sheep and use nutrition health care feed processing compounding device relates to feed processing technical field, including compounding mechanism, compounding mechanism contains a support holder, one side swing joint of a support holder has the pan feeding mouth. The utility model discloses a motor passes through gear track and drives the running gear and rotate, running gear drives a gangbar and rotates, a gangbar begins to drive the puddler and rotates, the nutrition groove sets up the upper end middle part at the apron, the apron lock joint is in the upper end of pan feeding mouth, stir the mixture earlier with inside ground fodder, stir after the certain time again, slowly pour the nutriment into the fodder along the nutrition groove on, carry out intensive mixing once more, can mix fodder and nutriment well, avoided fodder and nutriment to mix inhomogeneously, thereby the influence is bred the nutrition that cattle and sheep's nutrition intake breed cattle and sheep can ingest the nutrition well, the best effect of nutrition intake ground has been reached.

title: Nickel-cobalt bimetal phosphide nano composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a nickel-cobalt bimetallic phosphide nano composite material as well as a preparation method and application thereof. Firstly, adding foam metal into aqueous solution containing cobalt sulfate, ammonium fluoride, urea and polyvinylpyrrolidone to carry out hydrothermal reaction, taking out the foam metal, heating the foam metal to 200-250 ℃, and calcining the foam metal to obtain Co 3 O 4 /MF; then mixing Co 3 O 4 /MF is soaked in nickel nitrate water solution, and Ni (OH) is obtained through secondary hydrothermal reaction 2 @Co 3 O 4 /MF; finally mixing Ni (OH) 2 @Co 3 O 4 the/MF and the phosphate are respectively arranged in twoFeeding the quartz boats into a tube furnace together and calcining the quartz boats in a protective atmosphere to obtain a target product Ni 2 P @ CoP/MF. The invention prepares a novel core-shell nano-array, in which a large amount of tiny Ni is in the core-shell structure 2 The P nano-sheet is tightly wrapped on the CoP nano-wire to form a rich heterostructure interface, and the surface of the nano-wire becomes rough due to the phosphorization effect, and a plurality of tiny particles are attached on the surface of the nano-wire. The rough nanorod array core-shell structure can provide more electrochemical active sites and accelerate charge transfer.
